# IRIS – SIUE's Digital Humanities Center

> IRIS is Southern Illinois University Edwardsville's Digital Humanities Center, supporting transformative scholarship, community engagement, and inclusive digital projects across the humanities and social sciences.

IRIS serves as a hub for digital humanities research, teaching, and community partnerships at SIUE. The center offers consultations, workshops, equipment access, and hosts major projects including digital archives of African American literature, women writers, and linguistic fieldwork, alongside mentorship programs for underrepresented students in digital scholarship.

## Center Overview

- [IRIS – SIUE's Digital Humanities Center](https://iris.siue.edu): IRIS Center homepage showcasing digital humanities projects and initiatives
- [Our Mission – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/our-mission): IRIS Center mission statement and institutional overview
- [Our History – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/our-history): IRIS Center founding story and historical background by DeSpain and Hildebrandt
- [People – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/people): Faculty and staff directory including Margaret Smith and research team

## Digital Humanities Projects

- [Black Lit Network – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/portfolio/black-lit-network): Black Lit Network project by Howard Rambsy, digital archive of African American literature
- [Recovery Hub for American Women Writers – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/portfolio/recovery-hub-for-american-women-writers): Recovery Hub project led by DeSpain, collaborative women writers archive
- [Community-Oriented Digital Engagement Scholars – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/portfolio/community-oriented-digital-engagement-scholars): CODES program providing NEH-funded scholarship for underrepresented students
- [Schaefer Edoid Archive – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/portfolio/schaefer-edoid-archive): Digital archive of Edoid language fieldwork and ethnographic materials
- [RISE-DH – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/portfolio/rise-dh): RISE-DH mentorship program for African American students in digital humanities
- [St. Louis Area Digital Humanities Network – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/portfolio/st-louis-area-digital-humanities-network): Regional DH network connecting SIUE, Lindenwood, and area institutions

## Academic Programs

- [Digital Humanities and Social Sciences Minor – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/dhminor): DHSS minor program details, requirements, and faculty mentoring

## Support & Consultations

- [Request a Service – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/request-a-service): Service request portal for research and teaching consultations
- [Research Consultations – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/research-consultations): Research consultation services and project planning support
- [Teaching Consultations – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/teaching-consultations): Teaching consultation intake form and curriculum planning support
- [Classroom Visits – IRIS](https://iris.siue.edu/classroom-visits): Classroom visit program featuring tool tutorials and digital ethics
